name: check_replaceable
summary: For each thing, could a player place it again exactly where it stands, with every neighbour present? Asks the game's own placement cursor. Up to 1024 ids. Read only.

help.text: The thing itself is treated as gone; a refusal naming only it means its rules held, and its neighbours are checked again without it. It must also stand where the cursor snaps it, at a quarter turn. Run it over every piece a paste_blueprint placed: BlueprintMod skips these checks. place_structure and replace_walls refuse with the same rule (cannot_place).

reply.text: results [{reference_id, prefab_name, replaceable (true; false: the cursor would refuse; null: not checked), rule, reason}] in the order asked. rule: support (nothing to stand on or mount to), mount (behind it is something that does not take mounting, or the wrong face), host (the pipe, cable or machine it mounts on is missing or wrong), location (terrain, outside, rocket), adjacent (a port straight onto another device's port), collision, rotation, no_kit, off_grid. reason: the game's text, or why it is not checked (no placement cursor, not a structure, no such thing).

limits.text: A device whose own check stops at itself before the adjacent-port rule (vents, lights, consoles, APCs) is not checked for ports onto other ports; loose things inside are ignored. The game's frame cursor does not look at small-grid devices, so a frame can be placed around a station battery; that battery then answers false (support: it stands inside a frame, not on one).
